subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the following question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/584f0d7d572aeb33456f8cbf27a79258f9e221b741b2c59cacfe560a890c3782.png] 

As per the data available above, in which year was the percentage of population affected by cold was minimum?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Percentage of population affected by cold in the year 2020 = 10%

Percentage of population affected by cold in the year 1990 = 3.5%

Percentage of population affected by cold in the year 2000 = 7%

Percentage of population affected by cold in the year 2010 = 8%

**∴ The percentage of population affected by cold is minimum in the year 1990.**
